February 03, 2026 Grading

Mumei Shudan Aikido Kyu Grading - 8 February 2026

Good day everyone!

We’re excited to announce the upcoming Kyu Grading Event for all eligible members! Here are the details:

Date: Sunday, 8th Feb 2026 Time: 9:00 am - 12:00 PM Location: Mumei Shudan HQ

To secure your spot, please sign up as soon as possible using the provided link here!

Note that registration will only be confirmed once payment is received.

Regular training at Mumei Shudan HQ is strongly encouraged to help you prepare for this important milestone. Attending classes regularly is essential for your readiness, technique, and confidence in the grading process.

Let’s continue to train diligently and represent our dojo with pride. We look forward to seeing each of you put forth your best efforts on grading day!

Warmest Regards, Mumei Shudan Aikido Grading Committee
